# `scopeInLayerEffect`

Suggests using Layer.scoped instead of Layer.effect when Scope is in requirements

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Anti-pattern |
| Default severity | `warning` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377031` |
| Language Service name | `scopeInLayerEffect` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/scope-in-layer-effect` |

## Preview

```ts
import * as Context from "effect/Context"
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
import * as Layer from "effect/Layer"

class Cache extends Context.Tag("Cache")<Cache, { ok: true }>() {}
export const preview = Layer.effect(Cache, Effect.gen(function*() {
/**
                       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(scope-in-layer-effect): This layer construction leaves `Scope` in the requirement set. The scoped API removes `Scope` from the resulting requirements.
*/
  yield* Effect.addFinalizer(() => Effect.void)
/**
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
*/
  return { ok: true as const }
/**
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
*/
}))
/**
^^^
*/
```
